localWindowsAdapter.note: Uncommitted global.json for local builds only, because the Windows machine has SDK 10.0.401 and no 10.0.400. Never committed.

android.installedFor: SDK band 10.0.100 on the Windows host (SDK 10.0.401 installed, 10.0.400 pinned)

maui-android.installedFor: SDK band 10.0.100 on the Windows host (SDK 10.0.401 installed, 10.0.400 pinned)

mono-toolchain.installedFor: SDK band 10.0.100 on the Windows host; extended by the android workload for the Mono runtime and Mono AOT packs

trimmer.reason: The SDK adds this package implicitly at its own patch version: 10.0.11 in SDK 10.0.400 (WSL2) and 10.0.12 in SDK 10.0.401 (Windows local adapter). The explicit central pin keeps one lock for both.

android.minSdkSource: carried from the Kotlin baseline, unchanged by this pin; D-016 minimum-API review open

targetPlatformDecision.limit: 36.1 is the highest platform the pinned maui-android 10.0.20 workload accepts (37.0 is rejected, NETSDK1140). Raising it follows the workload and needs a new reviewed D-016 record.

android.jdkSource: JAVA_HOME environment variable, mapped to JavaSdkDirectory by the project; no path is committed
android.androidSdkSource: ANDROID_HOME or the default Android SDK location; no path is committed

signing.certificateSource: eng/published.py CERTIFICATE (public fingerprint; the keystore is never committed)
signing.signedBy: protected release job after the candidate build, outside MSBuild (AGENTS.md); MSBuild passes signing passwords as jarsigner arguments and MAUI 10.0.20 does not resolve env: references

deferrals.item: The Android build of the net10.0-android MAUI identity project on Linux. WSL2 Debian has no Android SDK or JDK 21, and toolchain installation there is performed by the user (P2-024), so it is not provisioned for AND.01.
deferrals.trigger: The first AND.40 hosted Linux CI run that builds the MAUI Android project (Debug and Release, locked restore).
deferrals.consequence: A failed Linux build reopens AND.01 and AND.40; the Windows build evidence stands until then.

deferrals.item: The BSD-2-Clause copyright notice of Xamarin.Android.Glide, a transitive MAUI dependency admitted by coordinator adjudication (2026-10-08, migration brief section 10).
deferrals.trigger: The first MAUI Android release candidate, before publication.
deferrals.consequence: The MAUI release notices must carry the notice; a candidate without it is not published and AND.40 stays open.

deferrals.item: The BSD-3-Clause licence text of Google.Protobuf 3.36.1, a transitive Mobile dependency. Its nupkg carries no licence file (eng/policy/nuget-admission.json, licenceFiles empty), so the notice is not packaged from the restored closure.
deferrals.trigger: The first MAUI Android release candidate, before publication.
deferrals.consequence: The MAUI release notices must carry the BSD-3-Clause licence text; a candidate without it is not published and AND.40 stays open.

deferrals.item: The Apache-2.0 licence text and any notice of Grpc.Core.Api 2.84.0, a transitive Mobile dependency. Its nupkg carries no licence file (eng/policy/nuget-admission.json, licenceFiles empty), so the notice is not packaged from the restored closure.
deferrals.trigger: The first MAUI Android release candidate, before publication.
deferrals.consequence: The MAUI release notices must carry the Apache-2.0 licence text and any notice; a candidate without them is not published and AND.40 stays open.

deferrals.item: The MIT licence and notice files of the admitted workload packs in eng/policy/workload-admission.json. The Mono runtime and Mono AOT packs contribute to the APK; the SDK and MAUI packs are build tooling.
deferrals.trigger: The first MAUI Android release candidate, before publication.
deferrals.consequence: The release notices must carry the workload pack licence and notice files; a candidate without them is not published and AND.40 stays open.

deferrals.item: Licence evidence that the reviewed Windows host cannot provide: the non-Windows host aliases of the Android SDK and Mono AOT packs (Microsoft.Android.Sdk.Linux and the linux-x64 and linux-arm64 Cross packs), and the licence statement of Microsoft.NET.Runtime.MonoAOTCompiler.Task and Microsoft.NET.Runtime.MonoTargets.Sdk, which ship a THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.TXT but no LICENSE.TXT. macOS host aliases are outside the delivery scope (P2-023).
deferrals.trigger: The first AND.40 hosted Linux CI run that installs the android workload and builds the MAUI Android project.
deferrals.consequence: A licence outside the admitted set or a missing licence file reopens AND.01 and AND.40.
